diff --git a/test/units/plugins/filter/test_core.py b/test/units/plugins/filter/test_core.py

 import pytest
+from jinja2.exceptions import UndefinedError
 
 from ansible.module_utils._text import to_native
-from ansible.plugins.filter.core import to_uuid
+from ansible.plugins.filter.core import to_nice_yaml, to_uuid, to_yaml
 from ansible.errors import AnsibleFilterError
+from ansible.template import AnsibleUndefined, Templar
+from units.mock.loader import DictDataLoader
 
 
 UUID_DEFAULT_NAMESPACE_TEST_CASES = (
@@ -39,3 +42,34 @@ def test_to_uuid_invalid_namespace():
     with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as e:
         to_uuid('example.com', namespace='11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555')
     assert 'Invalid value' in to_native(e.value)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_func', (to_yaml, to_nice_yaml))
+def test_yaml_filters_undefined_variable(filter_func):
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:
+        filter_func({'environment': AnsibleUndefined(name='MYSVC_ENV')})
+
+    assert filter_func.__name__ in str(error.value)
+    assert 'MYSVC_ENV' in str(error.value)
+    assert isinstance(error.value.orig_exc, UndefinedError)
+    assert 'MYSVC_ENV' in str(error.value.orig_exc)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_func', (to_yaml, to_nice_yaml))
+def test_yaml_filters_other_dump_failure(filter_func):
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:
+        filter_func(object())
+
+    assert filter_func.__name__ in str(error.value)
+    assert 'cannot represent an object' in str(error.value.orig_exc)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name', ('to_yaml', 'to_nice_yaml'))
+def test_yaml_filters_undefined_in_template(filter_name):
+    templar = Templar(loader=DictDataLoader({}), variables={})
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:
+        templar.template('{{ MYSVC_ENV | %s }}' % filter_name)
+
+    assert filter_name in str(error.value)
+    assert 'MYSVC_ENV' in str(error.value)
+    assert isinstance(error.value.orig_exc, UndefinedError)
